Coccidiosis.pesticide: Toltrazuril 2.5% (Baycox Vet) / Amprolium 20% Soluble Powder + Vitamin K3
Coccidiosis.dosage: 1 ml Baycox per 1 Liter drinking water for 2 consecutive days (24h continuous). For severe outbreaks: Amprolium 1.25g/L for 5-7 days.
Coccidiosis.administration_method: Oral via fresh morning drinking water; ensure no other water source is accessible.
Coccidiosis.organic: Organic Apple Cider Vinegar (5 ml/L) + Crushed Garlic Juice (2 ml/L) in drinking water for 5 days. Dust slaked lime on wet litter cakes.
Coccidiosis.organic_name: Garlic Extract & Apple Cider Vinegar Acidifier + Lime Bedding Sanitizer
Coccidiosis.precaution: Withdrawal period: 8 days for broiler meat. Maintain litter moisture strictly < 20% and clean drinker bells daily with Virkon-S.
Coccidiosis.emergency_first_aid: Immediately quarantine birds showing bloody droppings; administer Vitamin K3 (20 mg/L) to arrest internal hemorrhages.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Early Droopiness & Pale Combs
exemplar_images.hallmark: Ruffled feathers, huddling under brooder, and reduced water consumption.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Cecal Hemorrhagic Diarrhea
exemplar_images.hallmark: Blood-tinged mucus droppings, orange mucous feces, and severe dehydration.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Advanced Intestinal Sloughing
exemplar_images.hallmark: Severe flock emaciation, clumping of cecal cores, and high mortality.

Newcastle Disease.pesticide: ND LaSota Live Vaccine & Vimeral Immuno-Tonic
Newcastle Disease.medicine_name: Venky's ND LaSota Strain Vaccine + Vimeral (Vit A, D3, E, B12)
Newcastle Disease.dosage: 1000-dose live vaccine vial reconstituted in 15-20L chilled skimmed milk water (morning drink within 2h); 10 ml Vimeral / 100 birds daily.
Newcastle Disease.administration_method: Oral ocular drop or drinking water drench; administer Vimeral in evening water.
Newcastle Disease.organic: Raw Turmeric (200g) + Ginger (100g) + Tulsi (100g) + Black Pepper (20g) + Jaggery (500g) boiled decoction in 5L water; 20 ml/L drinking water.
Newcastle Disease.organic_name: Herbal Immuno-Booster Decoction (Turmeric, Ginger, Tulsi & Jaggery)
Newcastle Disease.precaution: Highly contagious: Strictly isolate shed. Burn or deeply bury all mortalities in 1-meter deep pit with lime. Never vaccinate moribund birds.
Newcastle Disease.emergency_first_aid: Immediate emergency vaccination of uninfected flock in adjoining sheds; provide Vitamin E + Selenium + Vitamin C in water to combat shock.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Respiratory Gasping & Greenish Diarrhea
exemplar_images.hallmark: Open-beak mouth breathing, tracheal rales, and profuse bright green watery feces.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Neurological Torticollis (Twisted Neck)
exemplar_images.hallmark: Head twisting backward (star-gazing), wing droop, and circular walking spasms.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Complete Paralysis & Prostration
exemplar_images.hallmark: Total loss of leg motor function, cyanotic comb darkening, and flock mortality.

Gumboro (IBD).pesticide: IBD Intermediate Plus Vaccine + Electral-Vet Potassium Citrate Kidney Flusher
Gumboro (IBD).medicine_name: Gumboro Intermediate Plus Live Vaccine + Nephrotec Liquid
Gumboro (IBD).dosage: Intermediate Plus vaccine at Day 12-14 in water; 5g Electral-Vet / Liter water for 4 consecutive days + 15 ml Nephrotec / 100 birds.
Gumboro (IBD).administration_method: Drinking water in cool morning hours; maintain 12-14h light.
Gumboro (IBD).organic: Boiled Coriander Seed decoction (250g) + Pure Jaggery (1 kg) + Rock Salt (50g) + Lemon Juice (100ml) per 1000 birds in morning water.
Gumboro (IBD).organic_name: Coriander-Jaggery Renal Cleanser & Electrolyte Rehydration Tonic
Gumboro (IBD).precaution: Temporarily reduce crude protein in feed to 16% to relieve acute kidney uric acid strain. Disinfect shed with Glutaraldehyde 20%.
Gumboro (IBD).emergency_first_aid: Provide electrolytes + glucose in drinking water to prevent dehydration; maintain warm brooding temperature (+2°F).

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Vent Pecking & Feathery Soiling
exemplar_images.hallmark: Birds pecking at their own vent, whitish-yellow watery diarrhea pasted to vent feathers.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Severe Prostration & Shivering
exemplar_images.hallmark: Extreme reluctance to move, ruffled plumage, subnormal body temperature, trembling.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Edematous Hemorrhagic Bursa
exemplar_images.hallmark: Enlarged gelatinous bursa with striations of hemorrhages, severe dehydration.

Salmonella (Pullorum).dosage: 1 ml Enrofloxacin 10% per 1 Liter drinking water for 5 consecutive days (10 mg/kg body weight).
Salmonella (Pullorum).administration_method: Oral in fresh daily drinking water for 5 continuous days.
Salmonella (Pullorum).organic: Oregano Essential Oil (Carvacrol 60%) 1 ml/3L + Garlic extract drench + acidified water (Citric Acid 1g/L).
Salmonella (Pullorum).organic_name: Carvacrol Oregano Oil & Acidified Garlic Antimicrobial Drench
Salmonella (Pullorum).precaution: Egg transmission risk: Do not use eggs from infected flock for incubation. Strict rodent control required.
Salmonella (Pullorum).emergency_first_aid: Quarantine sick chicks with chalky white vent pasting; flush water lines with 3% Hydrogen Peroxide.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Chalky White Pasted Vents
exemplar_images.hallmark: White diarrheal pasting around the cloaca, chirping in pain during defecation.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Somnolence & Huddling Under Heaters
exemplar_images.hallmark: Eyes closed, drooping wings, swollen hock joints, and extreme weakness.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Necrotic Foci in Liver & Heart
exemplar_images.hallmark: Bronze discoloration of liver, nodular myocarditis, and stunted flock growth.

Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD).dosage: 1g Tylodox per 1 Liter drinking water for 4-5 consecutive days + Bromhexine 1g/5L.
Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD).administration_method: Drinking water treatment morning and evening; aerosol shed misting.
Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD).organic: Eucalyptus Essential Oil (50ml) + Camphor (10g) shed aerosol fogging + Ginger-Peppermint extract in water (2 ml/L).
Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD).organic_name: Eucalyptus-Camphor Inhalation Fogging & Peppermint Mucus Reliever
Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD).precaution: Maintain shed side curtain ventilation; ensure toxic ammonia level is strictly < 15 ppm.
Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD).emergency_first_aid: Open side curtains for cross-ventilation; mist shed with eucalyptus-menthol spray to clear tracheal mucous plugs.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Nasal Exudate & Sneezing / Snicking
exemplar_images.hallmark: Clear to turbid nasal discharge, head shaking, and audible snicking at night.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Facial Swelling & Infraorbital Sinusitis
exemplar_images.hallmark: Puffy swollen eyes, closed eyelids glued with foamy exudate, and wheezing.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Caseous Airsacculitis & Cheesy Plugs
exemplar_images.hallmark: Thick yellow cheesy exudate in thoracic air sacs, severe respiratory distress.

Fowl Pox.pesticide: Fowl Pox Live Wing-Web Vaccine & 5% Povidone Iodine Ointment
Fowl Pox.medicine_name: Live Fowl Pox Vaccine (Wing Web) + Betadine 5% Antiseptic
Fowl Pox.dosage: Wing-web puncture at 6-8 weeks age. Paint external comb/wattle wart scabs with 5% Povidone Iodine twice daily.
Fowl Pox.administration_method: Wing-web bifurcated needle stab; topical ointment applicator.
Fowl Pox.organic: Cold-pressed Neem Oil (100ml) + Pure Organic Turmeric (50g) + Pure Honey (20g) healing balm applied with sterile cotton swab.
Fowl Pox.organic_name: Neem-Turmeric Antiseptic Healing Balm & Honey Dressing
Fowl Pox.precaution: Never forcibly peel dry scabs from eyes or comb to prevent massive hemorrhages and secondary bacterial infection.
Fowl Pox.emergency_first_aid: Isolate birds with throat diphtheritic patches; add Vitamin A + C to water to speed up epithelial tissue repair.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 1: Papular Nodules on Unfeathered Skin
exemplar_images.hallmark: Small yellowish-white blister-like papules on comb, wattles, and earlobes.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 2: Dark Wart-Like Scab Encrustation
exemplar_images.hallmark: Enlarged dark brown rough scab clusters coalescing across face and eyelids.

exemplar_images.title: Stage 3: Diphtheritic Wet Pox in Mouth Cavity
exemplar_images.hallmark: Yellow diphtheritic necrotic canker membranes in larynx causing asphyxiation.

Healthy Poultry.medicine_name: Liv-52 Vet Liquid & Vimeral Nutritional Tonic
Healthy Poultry.dosage: 10 ml Liv-52 / 100 birds + 5 ml Vimeral / 100 birds in drinking water twice weekly.
Healthy Poultry.administration_method: Drinking water supplementation for flock vitality.
Healthy Poultry.organic: Fresh Aloe Vera juice (10 ml/L) + Moringa leaf powder (1% in feed) + probiotic curds drench (10 ml/L).
Healthy Poultry.organic_name: Moringa Oleifera Herbal Feed Booster & Aloe Vera Gut Tonic
Healthy Poultry.precaution: Maintain biosecurity footbaths with 1% Virkon-S at shed entrance; test water microbial count monthly.
Healthy Poultry.emergency_first_aid: Maintain regular feeding schedules, clean water, and dry litter bedding.

exemplar_images.title: Exemplar 1: Vibrant Comb & Bright Clear Eyes
exemplar_images.hallmark: Deep crimson bright comb, erect posture, alert clear eyes, smooth tight plumage.

exemplar_images.title: Exemplar 2: Healthy Flock Uniformity & Foraging
exemplar_images.hallmark: Active feed pecking, uniform body weight distribution, normal firm droppings.

exemplar_images.title: Exemplar 3: Clean Dry Cloaca & Well-Formed Feces
exemplar_images.hallmark: Intact cloacal feathers with distinct white uric acid cap on firm fecal roll.
